title: A file whose field stamp is newer than meta.updatedAt is clamped and can lose a tie; confirm no real writer (web, engine, CLI, hosted MCP) can produce one
evidence: Found converting erase-machine-pins to fake timers (PR 1587): the test helper wrote a profile stamp 1 s ahead of meta.updatedAt; packages/health-core/src/migrate.ts sanitizeStamp clamps it and the value tie-break decides
